content: Weight loss maintenance programs endorsed by the American Diabetes Association (ADA) include very-low-calorie diets (VLCDs), which typically consist of 800 to 1,000 kilocalories per day. These diets are designed to be high in protein and often incorporate meal replacements. They have been shown to promote initial weight loss and improve glycemic control. However, it is critical that such diets are implemented under the supervision of trained healthcare professionals to ensure safety and effectiveness. These programs are generally intended for short-term use, particularly for individuals requiring intensive interventions or those preparing for surgical procedures.
